title: Searchable Lists with Scopes
hints: Filter by scope first, then by the query.
Use `localizedStandardContains` so case and accents don't matter.
An empty (trimmed) query matches everything in the scope.
jsBridge: `.searchable(text:)` plus search scopes filter a list by text and category. It's the React pattern of controlled search input plus derived filtered array, with SwiftUI supplying the search bar UI and scope picker.

compass.q: React: `const visible = useMemo(() => items.filter(...), [query])`. Where should the filtering live in SwiftUI: `body`, a computed property, or the model?
Filtering in memory vs a SwiftData `#Predicate` query: at what size do you move filtering into the store?
Case- and diacritic-insensitive search: `localizedStandardContains` vs `lowercased().contains`. Try "José".
Debouncing search input: needed for local filtering? For network search?
